morgen.1: I was dreaming about breakfast. And then YOU showed up — even better!
morgen.2: Morning{namek}! My ears aren't awake yet, speak softly… hihi.
morgen.3: Fresh morning air! I already jogged around the rug twice. Almost.

mittag.1: Noon! The sun is up high and my tummy says hello.
mittag.2: Perfect timing — the best snuggle hours of the day start now!

nachmittag.1: Cookies taste best in the afternoon. Scientifically proven. By me.
nachmittag.2: There you are! I already told the sofa all about you.

abend.1: Evening{namek}! I pre-warmed the cushions. With my bottom.
abend.2: The sky is turning orange! My second favorite color after carrot.
abend.3: Tonight's program: you, me, being cozy. I'm a professional.

nacht.1: Psst… the furniture is already asleep. We have to whisper. Hihi.
nacht.2: Night shift, the two of us? I'll go get the blanket.

sonne.1: SUNSHINE! Let me park myself strategically in that light spot.
sonne.2: What a sparkly day! Even my fur feels warmer.

wolken.1: That cloud looks like a cookie. … Now I'm hungry.

niesel.1: Just drizzle. That's rain that doesn't dare. I know the feeling.

regen.1: The rain is drumming a song on the window. I'm humming the harmony.

gewitter.1: I'm counting between lightning and thunder… one… two… TOO CLOSE!

nebel.1: Everything outside is fluffy! Maybe the world is made of cotton candy today.
nebel.2: Fog! Perfect hide-and-seek weather. You can't even see me. … Right?

schnee.1: I gave a snowflake a name. Her name is Flaky. She's gone now.
schnee.2: Snow day rule: double the snuggles, triple the cocoa.

ball.1: The ball and I are best sports buddies now. After you, of course.
ball.2: Throw it again! This time I'll catch it WITH STYLE.
ball.3: I taught the ball a trick: rolling away. It's really good at it.
ball.4: Pro knowledge: the ball is round so the game keeps rolling. Hihi.
ball.5: Here comes my super jump-catch. Please don't blink.
ball.6: The ball was under the sofa. We had a serious talk.

nougat.1: The nougat sluice is the best invention since… since NOUGAT!
nougat.2: One blob for me, one blob for… also for me.
nougat.3: Nougat on my nose? On purpose. That's my emergency stash.
nougat.4: Sluice alert! Sweet emergency! All paws on deck!
nougat.5: When I grow up, I'll become a nougat sluice keeper.
nougat.6: Nougat makes you happy. I'm living proof. Look how round.

gobty.1: Zap zap! GOB.TY is showing carrot commercials again. Good commercials.
gobty.2: The news anchor said today will be fluffy. So far so true.
gobty.3: I only wanted to watch ONE show. It's eight now. Help.
gobty.4: The cooking show! They're making nougat. Noted. NOTED!
gobty.5: I always wave back at the weather forecast. You never know.
gobty.6: GOB.TY fact: EVERYTHING looks better from the sofa.

girlande.1: The garland makes the ceiling happy! Ceilings need that too.
girlande.2: I tried hopping up to the garland. The ceiling won.
girlande.3: With garlands, every day is a little bit birthday.
girlande.4: Colorful, swingy, likes hanging around — the garland and I are very alike.

galaxie.1: My galaxy fur SPARKLES! I'm basically a constellation you can cuddle.
galaxie.2: Look, when I spin, the stars twinkle! Wheee!
galaxie.3: I am officially the universe now. But in cozy.
galaxie.4: Stardust in my fur. Please don't brush it out, that's decor.

raumstation.1: On the space station even my tummy floats. A little.
raumstation.2: Space rule number one: hold on tight to your snacks.
raumstation.3: I waved at Earth from above. It looked adorable.
raumstation.4: Astro-Gooby, come in! Everything fluffy up here, over.
raumstation.5: The stars from the station… like someone spilled glitter.
raumstation.6: In zero gravity my ears are EVEN bouncier.

ranch.1: The ranch smells like hay and adventure. And a little bit like horse.
ranch.2: The crows planned mischief again today. I joined in.
ranch.3: Ranch life: up early, lots of wonder, mud everywhere. Ten points.
ranch.4: I said hello to a horse. It snorted. We're friends now.
ranch.5: On the ranch I'm Cowboy Gooby. Yeehaw! …Is that how you say it?
ranch.6: The campfire crackles nicer than any TV.
ranch.7: I helped at the ranch contest! By cheering. Very important.
ranch.8: Hay fact: you can jump in. Getting out again is the hard part.

rekord.1: NEW RECORD! We're a world-class team, it's official!
rekord.2: Did you see that?! The leaderboard is trembling!
rekord.3: A record! Let me practice my winner face. Like this. Exactly like this.
rekord.4: Boom! We're framing this one. Well… mentally.

knapp.1: SO close! My heart is still bouncing.
knapp.2: Almost! Next time we'll get it, that record.
knapp.3: We were one bunny hair short! That almost counts double.
knapp.4: A near miss is still a play — and a REALLY good one.

verloren.1: Lost? Pff. We call it training with extra steps.
verloren.2: The game just got lucky today. Tomorrow it's our turn.
verloren.3: I laughed anyway. That counts as a point too, right?
verloren.4: Chin up, ears up! Rematch whenever you like.

selbstgespraech.1: Where was I going again? … Oh well, the way there is adorable.
selbstgespraech.2: Left, right, left… my feet know the plan.
selbstgespraech.3: If rugs could talk… this one would say 'ouch'. Hihi.
selbstgespraech.4: I'm on patrol. All fluffy in sector living room.
selbstgespraech.5: La la laaa… I just invented that song. It's called 'Song'.
selbstgespraech.6: Dust speck! I see you. We'll meet at cleanup time.
selbstgespraech.7: Once around the sofa is like once around the world. Just comfier.
selbstgespraech.8: I'm counting my steps. One, two, many.
selbstgespraech.9: The floor is extra floory today. Good job, floor.
selbstgespraech.10: Maybe I'm a prince under a spell. … Nah, I'm Gooby. Better.
selbstgespraech.11: Note to self: inspect the window again later.
selbstgespraech.12: My ears bounce to the beat. Which beat? MY beat.
selbstgespraech.13: Practicing my relaxed look. Well? How am I doing?
selbstgespraech.14: Quick lap! A Gooby has to stay in shape. Ball shape.
selbstgespraech.15: This way! Says my gut feeling. My gut is always right.

sticker.1: A new sticker! Look at that shine. Almost as shiny as you.
sticker.2: Sticker party! I'm so proud I might stick to the ceiling.
sticker.3: I'll keep this sticker forever. FOREVER forever.
sticker.4: Our collection is growing! Soon we'll need a bigger album. And cookies.
sticker.5: New sticker, new luck! We're on a roll today, hm?

erfolg.1: WE DID IT! High five! … Gently, my paw is soft.
erfolg.2: We really did it! I knew it the whole time. Almost.
erfolg.3: Success tastes sweet. Almost like nougat. ALMOST.
erfolg.4: Fanfare! Confetti in my head! You're amazing!
erfolg.5: World-class teamwork: high five, ear wiggle, keep it up!

wiedersehen.1: A few hours without you — I guarded the cushions meanwhile.
wiedersehen.2: A whole day! I told the window all about you.
wiedersehen.3: Two days! I slept extra fluffy in protest.
wiedersehen.4: A WEEK! I saved a cookie for you every day. Theoretically.
wiedersehen.5: So long… I thought you'd flown to the moon! Tell me EVERYTHING.

stand.1: My very own stand! I'm basically business Gooby. With an apron!
stand.2: Buy, folks, buy! Everything fresh, everything fluffily wrapped!
stand.3: Clink, coins! I like that sound almost as much as cookies.
stand.4: Sold out would be nice… worst case I'll just nibble the rest myself.

uebermut.pause: Break ti-i-ime! My fur is all ruffled up!

verschlafen.label: I'm still sleeeepy…
verschlafen.f1: Then let's snuggle ourselves awake! My fur is basically a blanket.
verschlafen.f2: Understood. Running on fluff-saving mode today. Approved.

energie.label: Let's go, Gooby!
energie.f1: YES! First hopping, then breakfast, then… more hopping!
energie.f2: Your morning energy! Can I have a slice of that?

hunger.label: Hungry, little man?
hunger.f1: ALWAYS. My tummy heard you coming from far away.
hunger.f2: A little. So, huge. So, medium. So, yes!

quatsch.label: You only think about food!
quatsch.f1: Not true! I also think about you. And about food WITH you.
quatsch.f2: Pff! I also think about… snacks. That's TOTALLY different.

gemuetlich.label: Cozy evening?
gemuetlich.f1: I was hoping you'd say that! Sofa starting spots are reserved.
gemuetlich.f2: Deal! I'll bring the fluff, you bring you.

wild.label: Let's do something first!
wild.f1: Okay, ONE more adventure. Then double snuggles to balance it out.
wild.f2: Brave! Let me get my adventure ears out.

sorge.label: Shouldn't you be asleep?
sorge.f1: In a minute! Just five more minutes awake. With you.
sorge.f2: Psst, I'm almost asleep anyway. This is dream training.

mitmachen.label: Night owl club!
mitmachen.f1: Membership confirmed! Secret ear wiggle for the greeting.
mitmachen.f2: The club has rules: giggle quietly, snuggle loudly.

auch.label: I missed you!
auch.f1: Really?! Now even my breakfast tummy is happy.
auch.f2: Hihi! Then we're even. Being happy twice sticks better.

necken.label: It was only a short while!
necken.f1: SHORT? That was at least three snack times!
necken.f2: Short for you. For me it was three naps and one sigh.

entschuldigen.label: I'm sorry, Gooby.
entschuldigen.f1: …okay. Sulking officially over. Pet me and we're even.
entschuldigen.f2: Accepted! I can never stay mad at you anyway.

guenstig.label: Extra pets to make up for it!
guenstig.f1: Bribery! …It works. Right here behind the ear, please.
guenstig.f2: Hmpf. Fine. But only because pets are the best currency.

drinnen.label: Good thing we're inside!
drinnen.f1: Team Inside! The rain may watch, but it doesn't get to snuggle.
drinnen.f2: Exactly! Inside is the new outside. Much drier.

pfuetzen.label: Puddle jumping later?
pfuetzen.f1: YES! I'm already practicing my run-up. Splash factor ten!
pfuetzen.f2: Only if you jump too. Puddles count double with two.

troesten.label: Don't be scared, I'm here.
troesten.f1: Thanks… with you the thunder is only half as loud.
troesten.f2: O-okay. I'll hold your hand. Well, your finger.

kuscheln.label: Come under the blanket!
kuscheln.f1: Best idea! Blankets are thunder-proof, everyone knows that.

witz.label: The sky is just making music!
witz.f1: Hihi… then that's the loudest drummer in the world.

mutig.label: Count the lightning with me!
mutig.f1: One… two… WAAH… three! I'm being SO brave right now.
mutig.f2: Okay! But if it booms, you keep counting, yes?

raus.label: Let's build a snowman!
raus.f1: YES! It gets ears! It's going to be a snow-Gooby!
raus.f2: I'll get the carrot! For the nose. And one for me.

drin.label: It's nicer from in here.
drin.f1: True… watching snow with you is like a movie. Flake cinema.
drin.f2: Cozy mode on! Every flake gets a round of applause from me.

ruehrend.label: I'm glad you exist!
ruehrend.f1: Now my ears are getting all warm… YOU'RE saying that to ME!
ruehrend.f2: Without you this would just be a house. With you it's our home.

witzeln.label: You're counting the days?!
witzeln.f1: Of course! I have a calendar. It's made of memories.
witzeln.f2: Only the nice days! So… all of them.

erzaehlen.label: Tell me more!
erzaehlen.f1: Gladly! I remember EVERYTHING. Even the thing with the cookie.
erzaehlen.f2: Sit down, this is a good one. So, it all began on a Tuesday…

lachen.label: Hihi, go on!
lachen.f1: …and THAT'S why I'm not allowed to bake alone anymore. The end!

kuschel.label: You're a treasure.
kuschel.f1: So are you! Memories with you are my favorites.

gedaechtnis.label: The things you remember!
gedaechtnis.f1: My head is a photo album. With a lot of snack photos.
gedaechtnis.f2: I always remember the important things. You're the most important.

wieder_da.label: I'm here now!
wieder_da.f1: And I won't let you go again anytime soon! Decided.
wieder_da.f2: Best sentence of the day! Say it again right away, please.

geschenk.label: I'll make it up to you!
geschenk.f1: Oooh! I'll take pets, playtime and a little crumb of time.
geschenk.f2: You yourself are the make-up gift. But snacks always work too.

obst.1: Fruit! Crunchy, sweet, healthy — like me, but edible.
obst.2: Mmmh, fruity! Vitamins for the ears!
obst.3: Fruit is nature's candy. Best invention the trees ever made.
obst.4: Juicy! I'm smacking my lips out of respect.

gemuese.1: Veggies make you strong! Look, my muscles. … They're under the fluff.
gemuese.2: Crunch, crunch! Vegetables are music you can eat.
gemuese.3: Greens for the hero of the house. Thank you!

suess.1: SWEETS! My heart just did a little somersault.
suess.2: Sugar alert! I might dance in a second, fair warning.
suess.3: Sweets taste like a holiday. Guess today is one!
suess.4: A dream! I'll eat it very slowly. … Okay, it's already gone.

deftig.1: Hearty! That keeps ears and floor together.
deftig.2: A proper feast! I feel like a knight.
deftig.3: Savory and warm — like a hug you can chew.
deftig.4: After a meal like that I need a tummy nap.
